text:
kai: running examples/go-starter with OTEL_LOG_INJECTION=true, saw early logs with `request_id=undefined` and later logs OK. also noticed repeated `[REDACTED]` fragments in multi-header traces.

anya: thanks for flagging. raw sample?

kai: `2026-08-04T10:01:02Z INFO http.request path=/chat request_id=undefined user_email=[REDACTED]` then on next request `request_id=xyz-123`

mike: sounds like an init-order race: reqid middleware not set when first logs emitted. we should never stringify nil as "undefined".

anya: agree. recommended quick fix: in logger middleware use safe lookup `rid, _ := ctx.Value(reqIDKey).(string); if rid=="" { rid="-" }` and delay log subsystem init until hooks registered, or make init idempotent.

kai: for the duplicate redaction, sample has REDWOOD_REDACT_PATTERNS='(api_key|token|secret)'. seems our redactor and the OTEL exporter both run and second pass mangles bracketed placeholders, producing `[REDACTED]-[REDACTED]` in some headers.

mike: make redaction idempotent: skip replacement if value already contains `[REDACTED]` or change regex to not match bracketed text. add unit tests for two-pass redaction.

anya: also add a CI smoke test in examples/ci that starts sample with OTEL enabled and fails on `request_id=undefined` or consecutive `[REDACTED]` patterns.

ops-bot: NOTE: created issue #4622 (devex) "go-starter: startup race yields undefined reqid + non-idempotent redactor" by kai

kai: i'll open a small PR with the safe cast, redactor early-out, and a repro script. pinging @eng-runtime for merge impact.

mike: nice. also consider documenting OTEL interaction in examples/README to reduce onboarding confusion.

anya: thanks everyone, will review PR when it lands :rocket:
